BasicProjectile.name: Basic Projectile
BasicProjectile.description: A simple projectile that moves in a straight line and can damage targets on contact.

BasicPropellant.name: Basic Propellant
BasicPropellant.description: A basic gunpowder propellant that provides a moderate amount of thrust to projectiles.

BasicCasing.name: Basic Casing
BasicCasing.description: A standard casing that holds the propellant and projectile together.

ScatterCasing.name: Scatter Casing
ScatterCasing.description: A casing that holds many small pellets, increasing the area of effect, but reducing damage per fragment.

EnemyCasing.name: Enemy Casing
EnemyCasing.description: [Internal Only] A casing fired by enemies, which may have different properties such as speed, damage, or special effects.

HomingPropellant.name: Homing Propellant
HomingPropellant.description: A propellant that allows the projectile to home in on targets, increasing accuracy but potentially reducing speed.

FrangibleProjectile.name: Frangible Projectile
FrangibleProjectile.description: A projectile that scatters into multiple shards after hitting an enemy, increasing spread but decreasing damage per shard.

HeavyPropellant.name: Heavy Propellant
HeavyPropellant.description: A propellant that increases projectile damage and size while decreasing its speed

PiercingProjectile.name: Piercing Projectile
PiercingProjectile.description: A projectile that makes the bullet pierce through multiple enemies at full damage!

BurstCasing.name: Burst Casing
BurstCasing.description: A casing that shoots three times in a row. How is that even possible?

BoomerangPropellant.name: BOOMerang
BoomerangPropellant.description: A propellant that makes the projectile return to where it came from. Maybe not the best idea

RapidFireCasing.name: Rapid Fire Casing
RapidFireCasing.description: A casing of 10 small pellets, fired over time and dealing reduced damage on hit. Great to overwhelm a large amount of enemies.

MatryoshkaProjectile.name: Matryoshka Projectile
MatryoshkaProjectile.description: A Russian classic. This projectile releases smaller versions of itself on hit, hurdling towards the next enemy.
